searchText: a sender frame is guaranteed to fail if it runs before any frame has approved execution. currently this fails at runtime. could we add a static check: reject a frame tx whose sender frame appears before any frame with an execution flag?

excerpts.author: raxhvl
excerpts.content:
a sender frame is guaranteed to fail if it runs before any frame has approved execution.

currently this fails at runtime.

could we add a static check: reject a frame tx whose sender frame appears before any frame with an execution flag?
